items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: his drummer that plays like Buddy Rich, what's his name? Well, I just can't remember.

ctx.x: Bob Wilbur, is he with you?

No, I had, uh, Harry Green on clarinet, and his drummer that plays like Buddy Rich, what's his name? Well, I just can't remember. Anyway, I'm sure you work all over there. Most of the guys, uh, most of the guys were at the, uh, Rhymes. So we came out here, and we stayed, uh, we were supposed to be there two weeks, and we stayed six months. And at the weekends, it was beginning to pick up mouth-to-mouth publicity. So then I got an offer to go into the Blue Note. And just then, the band quit me, went back to New…
